name: Free TAFE (Victoria)
summary: Tuition-free places in priority TAFE courses for eligible students training in Victoria.
key: If you are eligible for Free TAFE, all your tuition fees will be covered.
who: Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand citizens training in Victoria
Asylum seekers may be eligible under the Asylum Seeker VET Program
how: Your TAFE provider confirms your eligibility when you enrol
catches: You might still pay for books or equipment
Usually only one Free TAFE course, with some exceptions such as priority pathways

evidence.claim: Prior qualifications don't matter for first course
